schema: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal AND tgrelid IN ('dispatcharr_channels_recording'::regclass,'dispatcharr_channels_channel'::regclass,'epg_programdata'::regclass,'vod_movie'::regclass,'vod_vodlogo'::regclass))
recording_read: SELECT channel_id::bigint,CASE WHEN octet_length(custom_properties::text)<=8192 THEN custom_properties ELSE NULL END,(custom_properties IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(custom_properties::text)<=8192) FROM dispatcharr_channels_recording WHERE id=$1 LIMIT 2
movie_read: SELECT l.id::bigint,CASE WHEN octet_length(l.url)<=1024 THEN l.url ELSE NULL END,(l.url IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(l.url)<=1024) FROM vod_movie m LEFT JOIN vod_vodlogo l ON l.id=m.logo_id WHERE UPPER(m.name::text)=UPPER($1) ORDER BY m.name LIMIT 2
update: UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_recording SET custom_properties=$1 WHERE id=$2 AND custom_properties=$3
